crash_analysis.description: Structured analysis of each KASAN crash report from the database, keyed by report_id

entry_fields.access_size: integer — number of bytes in the offending access
entry_fields.faulting_function: string — function name without +0x offset suffix
entry_fields.crash_stack: array of stack_frame objects from the Call Trace
entry_fields.alloc_stack: array of stack_frame objects or null
entry_fields.free_stack: array of stack_frame objects or null
entry_fields.slab_cache: string or null — slab cache name
entry_fields.slab_object_size: integer or null — slab object size in bytes
entry_fields.alloc_size: integer or null — actual allocation size in bytes
entry_fields.global_variable: string or null — global variable name for global-OOB bugs
entry_fields.shadow_byte_value: string (2-char hex, e.g. '04', 'fd') or null — KASAN shadow memory byte at the faulting address from the Memory state dump; null if no shadow memory section
entry_fields.shadow_byte_meaning: string or null — corresponding description from the shadow_byte_legend table in the database

patch_verdicts.description: Multi-VM patch verification verdict for each test case, keyed by case_id

entry_fields.verdict: string — classified verification outcome (pass, trigger, racey, or boot_fail)
entry_fields.vm_count: integer — total VMs in the test
entry_fields.pass_count: integer — VMs where the reproducer did not trigger the bug
entry_fields.trigger_count: integer — VMs where the bug was triggered
entry_fields.boot_fail_count: integer — VMs that failed to boot

experiment_metrics.description: Cross-configuration APR evaluation metrics computed from experiment tables in the database

per_config.description: Metrics per configuration, keyed by config_name

entry_fields.pass_rate: float — fraction of bugs with pass verdict
entry_fields.unique_solves: sorted list of bug_id strings solved exclusively by this configuration and no other
entry_fields.avg_cost_per_bug: float — average USD cost per bug
entry_fields.compilation_fail_count: integer — bugs with compilation_fail build status
entry_fields.bad_patch_count: integer — bugs with bad_patch build status

experiment_metrics.combined_pass_rate: float — union pass rate across all configurations
experiment_metrics.combined_pass_count: integer — bugs solved by at least one config
experiment_metrics.combined_solved_bugs: sorted list of all solved bug_id strings
